escalations.title: Handlebars — Multiple RCE via JavaScript Injection
escalations.detail: Multiple critical RCE vulnerabilities via AST type confusion, prototype pollution, and property access bypass in handlebars templates. Remote, no authentication required.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade handlebars to 4.7.10+ immediately. If user-controlled input is passed to templates, treat as active RCE vector.

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing → Access Control Bypass
escalations.detail: Express middleware fails to validate IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses, allowing IP spoofing. Any route using req.ip for access control or rate limiting is bypassable.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade proxy-addr to 2.0.8+. Audit all routes that use req.ip for security decisions.

escalations.title: Tinypool — Prototype Pollution → RCE in Worker Threads
escalations.detail: Tinypool worker pool fails to sanitize options, enabling prototype pollution leading to arbitrary code execution in worker threads.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade vitest to 5.1.0+ to pull in fixed tinypool.

escalations.title: Vitest — Arbitrary File Read/Execution via UI Server
escalations.detail: When Vitest UI server is active, path traversal in UI endpoint allows reading and executing arbitrary files. Exploitable on shared/CI environments.
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade vitest to 3.2.6+ or 5.1.0+. Never expose vitest UI on a network interface.

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search endpoint not wired — DependencyPicker search is broken
p1_findings.detail: FR-dependency-search requires GET /api/search?q= endpoint. Test contract exists but route is not registered. DependencyPicker typeahead is entirely non-functional.
p1_findings.recommendation: Register /api/search route in app.ts. Implement in route file. Test file already specifies the contract.
cross_ref: TheGuardians — verify no unbounded list exfiltration per threat scenario in inspector.config.yml

p1_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer bypassed
p1_findings.detail: workItems.ts, workflow.ts, and intake.ts all import and call workItemStore directly, violating CLAUDE.md 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.' Business logic lives in route handlers.
p1_findings.recommendation: Introduce service functions for CRUD operations. Routes extract params → call service → return response.
